question: A can complete a task in 12 days and B can complete the same task in 18 days. They start working together but A works for only 2 days. The remaining work is completed by B. If the total wage is ₹2,400, then what is B's share (in ₹)?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete a task in 12 days 

B can complete the same task in 18 days.

Total wage = ₹2,400

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ One day work of A = 1/12

⇒ One day work of B = 1/18

⇒ One day work of A and B = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36

⇒ Two day work of (A + B) = 5/18

⇒ Remaining work = 1 - 5/18 = 13/18

Now B can complete the remaining work in = 13/18 × 18 = 13 days

A did work for 2 days = 1/6 part of the work

B did work for 15 days = 5/6 part of work

Now taking ratio of work of A to that of B = 1 : 5

Now,

⇒ 1k + 5k = 2400

⇒ 6k = 2400

⇒ k = 2400/6 = 400

Share of B = 5 × 400 = Rs. 2000

**∴ The share of B will be Rs. 2000.**
